# BlockBuddies Offline v1.5.91

This release turns the town's four workplaces into deeper, replayable
mini-games with changing orders, performance rewards, and career progression.

## Better job mini-games

- Shopkeeper shifts now include shelf sorting, checkout maths, and customer
  service with changing products and requests.
- Restaurant shifts now test ingredient preparation, cooking methods, and
  serving the correct meal.
- Delivery shifts now vary package labels, cargo-care rules, recipients, and
  destinations across the streamed work district.
- Farming shifts now vary crops, growing conditions, soil care, and harvest
  quality.
- Each shift generates one coherent set of orders and presents clear answer
  choices at every work station.
- Wrong choices give useful feedback and allow another attempt without
  forfeiting the base wage.

## Scoring and progression

- Added live timers, overtime, points, accuracy combos, star ratings, and tips.
- Added faster rush shifts every third completed shift.
- Added persistent mastery XP, profession levels, career ranks, best scores,
  best star ratings, perfect-shift totals, and higher-level pay bonuses.
- Added First Paycheck and Job Specialist badges.
- Updated the work menu with profession progress bars and career statistics.

## NPCs, feedback, and mobile polish

- Managers announce the current generated order and the exact final payout.
- Customers change names, requests, destinations, and success reactions.
- Added distinct sounds for starting work, correct answers, mistakes, and
  completed shifts.
- Added a phone-friendly task challenge screen and moved the active-shift HUD
  below the minimap on small displays.
- Confirmed that tips, wages, and first-time quest bonuses all use the central
  coin-award path and persist correctly.

## Regression coverage

- Added deterministic order-generation, task-order, retry, scoring, star,
  tip, mastery, rush, overtime, migration, audio, map, HUD, and challenge UI
  tests.
- Completed phone-sized gameplay QA through a full shopkeeper shift, including
  an incorrect answer, recovery, NPC reactions, and final coin payment.

## Android updates

- Uses the production package ID `com.blockbuddies.offline`.
- Retains the exact v1.5.79 update-signing identity so existing installations
  can update normally.
